## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Rome, Italy. It starts at 13,Via delle Quattro Fontane.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Age before beauty? Not when it comes to art! See both combined at Palazzo Barberini, home to Renaissance highlights from Raphael, Caravaggio and more. See the frescoed ceiling, crucifixes and works by regional painters of popes and cardinals and get free access to Palazzo Corsini.

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €17.98. It was rated 4.3 out of 5 from 239 ratings and 85 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
